newsitem.title: USA: Cascade to use Rockwell 56K modem.
newsitem.headline: Cascade to use Rockwell 56K modem.

text.p: WESTFORD, Mass., Oct 17 - Cascade Communications Corp said it planned to use higher speed 56 kilobit second modem technology from Rockwell International Corp in its new AX 800 and AX 1600 High Capacity Access Switches.

In a statement, Cascade said it will use the new technology to roughly double the speed of modems that are part of its carrier-class central site access products. These systems are sold to central access providers to handle traffic over the Internet.
The company said its strategic relationship with Rockwell will allow the two companies to respond rapidly as the market for 56K modem technology develops throughout 1997.
The statement did not say when Cascade planned to release its own products.
